name: The Quay
description: Innovate takes place at The Quay on Toronto's East waterfront—a contemporary event space with large windows, natural wood accents, and room for focused programming and networking.

gettingThere.title: Arrival, parking, and walking
gettingThere.intro: The event space is on the 3rd floor of 100 Queens Quay East. Underground parking is in the building, and Union Station is about a 10-minute walk.

arrival.title: Finding the event space
steps: The lobby entrance is on Queens Quay East, to the right of the LCBO doors.
The event space is on the 3rd floor.
From the lobby, take the elevators to the left of the security desk.

parking.title: Underground parking
parking.paidNote: Parking is paid on site and is not included with registration.
notes: Enter from Cooper Street or John M. Tinsley Street.
The garage has a direct elevator to the building lobby.

walking.title: Walking from Union Station
steps: Exit Union Station onto Front Street and head toward Bay Street.
Turn left on Queens Quay East.
100 Queens Quay East is on your left. The Quay event space is on the 3rd floor.

onSite: Single-room program flow for easy navigation between sessions
Registration desk and light breakfast from 7:30 AM
Lunch and sponsor showcase included for registered attendees
